description: This PHP class defines a validation rule for review reviewer ratings within the OrangeHRM Performance module. It validates an array of ratings against certain criteria, such as existence of KPI IDs, membership in the review, and rating bounds, using dependency-injected services.

classes.name: ReviewReviewerRatingParamRule
classes.description: A validation rule that checks the correctness of reviewer ratings for performance review KPIs based on various business rules and data fetched via services.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the rule with a specific review ID for validation context.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation on the provided ratings array, ensuring each rating entry meets criteria including KPI ID validity, review association, and rating bounds.
